Triggers: Audio URL parameter is empty or not available
Behavior: Raises ValueError and terminates task execution with Error status.

Triggers: Relative local static file path not found on disk
Behavior: Falls back to downloading from the local server HTTP endpoint.

Triggers: Connection timeouts or non-200 HTTP statuses
Behavior: Raises HTTPError and terminates task execution with Error status.

Triggers: Audio file has invalid codec/headers or is corrupted
Behavior: Pipeline catches exception and falls back to dynamic transcript segment evaluation.

Triggers: pyannote-audio package is missing from workspace environment
Behavior: Diarization is skipped and empty list of segments returns.

Triggers: Missing or invalid Hugging Face access token
Behavior: Logs warning and skips PyAnnote pipeline initialization.

Triggers: No connection when downloading checkpoint details during lazy load
Behavior: Raises download error and terminates task.

Triggers: PyTorch / TorchMetrics modules fail or are missing
Behavior: Logs warning and falls back to default MOS quality score of 4.0.

Triggers: Transformers packages or model checkpoints fail to load
Behavior: Logs error and returns default neutral sentiment map {"neutral": 1.0}.

Triggers: Raw conversation ID strings sent directly to query context
Behavior: Coercion to uuid.UUID object at the pipeline entry point ensures cross-compatibility with SQLite dialect.
